premises.text: Bicycle theft is a significant problem worldwide, with billions of euros lost each year.
premises.evidence_span: Bicycle theft is a huge problem worldwide, with over 5.7 billion euros of stolen bicycles every year.

premises.text: Current bike security technology is not sufficiently advanced.
premises.evidence_span: bike security tech today is not that advanced.

premises.text: A truly smart lock must have an alarm, be secure, GPS trackable, and keyless.
premises.evidence_span: it has to have an alarm. It has to be secure. And it has to be GPS trackable, because we don't know if it might fail eventually. And above all, it has to have a keyless mechanism.

premises.text: Lock8 incorporates advanced sensors to detect tampering.
premises.evidence_span: the sensors inside Lock8 are truly advanced.

premises.text: Lock8 can send notifications to users if tampering is detected.
premises.evidence_span: if the tamper is detected, your bike might be at risk. And it gives me that notification immediately.

premises.text: Lock8 allows users to rent their bikes to others.
premises.evidence_span: if you want to make money with your bike, you can rent your bike out to whoever you want.

premises.text: Lock8 can facilitate connected mobility without needing connected infrastructure.
premises.evidence_span: we don't need connected infrastructure. We just need simple devices in Lock8.

value.text: Lock8 provides enhanced security and rental options for bicycles.
value.evidence_span: your bike will be safe. In addition to this, we can have connected mobility.

notes: No separate premises for features of the app as they are part of the Lock8 functionality.
